title: Kotlin Quiz
description: Review the 12 starter lessons. The questions name the example to revisit. Take your time, use the lessons, and read the reason after each answer.

questions.question: main is the starting function. println prints a value on a new line. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: main is the entry point. println writes one string and a newline. A program needs a main function to start here.

questions.question: val gives a name to a value that cannot be reassigned. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: val binds pencils to 3. Adding 2 creates the printed result 5. Use var only if the binding must change.

questions.question: var lets you assign a new value. += adds to the current number. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: var allows the += line to replace 3 with 5. A variable keeps its type even when its value changes.

questions.question: A dollar sign places a variable value inside a Kotlin string. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: $name inserts Ravi into the surrounding text. Use ${...} for an expression, not just $.

questions.question: if can return a value. Both branches below produce a message. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: The true if condition chooses Pass as the value of message. An if used as a value needs an else branch.

questions.question: listOf makes a read-only list. The first item has index zero. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: listOf stores cat at zero and dog at one. Index 1 reads dog. Use a mutable list when you need add or remove operations.

questions.question: The range 1..3 includes both ends. for reads each number. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: The .. range includes 3, so there are three loop values. 1 until 3 leaves out 3.

questions.question: A function gives steps a name. This expression body returns n times two. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: The expression body after = returns n * 2. Input 4 gives 8. Write a type for each function input.

questions.question: A question mark makes a type nullable. ?: supplies a fallback for null. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: The nullable name is null. The ?: operator chooses Guest. The !! operator can crash when the value is null.

questions.question: ?. only calls a property or method when the value is not null. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: The safe call skips length on null. Its null result is replaced by 0. A safe call may return null, so handle that result too.

questions.question: A data class stores fields and supplies useful data operations such as copy. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: copy keeps title and makes a new record with 30 pages. The old record is unchanged. copy makes a new value; it does not change the original.

questions.question: when picks a branch for a value. else handles the values not listed. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
questions.explanation: The green branch matches and returns Go to println. A when used as a value must cover every possibility.
